**Daily Devotional**

**June 24**

*22 Flee also youthful lusts: but follow righteousness, faith, charity, peace, with them that call on the Lord out of a pure heart. (2 Timothy 2:22 KJV)*

Lust is not always sexual, but any strong desire for something, and younger people often have very strong desires for things, and just having fun. The older one gets the more you tend to stay focused on work and other life matters. The older person normally realizes that poverty comes from not working hard (Proverbs 28:19). Those that want to just have all fun will lose God’s Word out of their hearts (Luke 8:14). Also it is a sign of the end times when people seek pleasure over seeking God (2 Timothy 3:4).

We need to all follow righteousness, faith, charity, and peace with a pure heart, and those things are what should set the Christian apart from the rest of the world. If we would just love God, like He loves us, and love our neighbor as ourselves (Matthew 22:37-39), we would set such an example to the rest of the world, that we would make the kingdom come on earth as it is in heaven. Remember that your life as a Christian may be the only bible that some people ever read, and if your life doesn’t glorify God, then your witness will not produce the salvation of others. Let your light shine for the Lord (Matthew 5:16). Thank you Jesus!
